chunks: Tell: O my people, act according to your position/state, I am acting. You will soon know whose is the outcome of the abode. Indeed, the righteous will not succeed.

key_terms.عَاقِبَةُ الدَّارِ: the outcome/consequence of the abode (the Hereafter)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'act according to your position' in Surah Al-An'am?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a call for steadfastness in one's specific role and station, whether in worship or governance, while awaiting divine judgment. It underscores the concept of 'Aqibat al-Dar' (the end of the abode), emphasizing that ultimate success belongs to those who maintain righteousness despite the temporary dominance of the oppressors. This reassures the faithful that the fate of the unjust is sealed, reinforcing the Shia hope in the eventual triumph of the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers.
